task: simulate executability and surface UNDEFINED discoveries
brief: A lightweight LMS for a university department: assignments, plagiarism checks, gradebook and attendance.

evidence.title: Product one-pager
evidence.content: Scope: pilot with 50 users. Success: 80% of target workflows completed in-app without phone support. Constraints: launch before the semester starts; no stored card data.

evidence.title: Ops constraints memo
evidence.content: Budget covers one engineer and one designer for 3 months. All data must stay on local hosting. Support channel is WhatsApp-first; email secondary.
